aiGuidance.extraction: One signal key per entry, e.g. problem.affirmed.

description: Signals that earn this grade: any one that holds for a work item gives the item this grade, the highest earned grade wins. Each key names an evaluator the clerk implements (its signal catalogue); an unknown key fails the clerk's policy check.
